Our invoice lists “Embeddings, Aug 3-9” twice. Can you credit the duplicate? Org copperleaf-ai.

{"name": "charge-review", "steps": "Inputs: the developer's org or account id, the invoice (id or month), the lines and amounts they mean, request ids if they have them.

1. Identify the account. If you have neither org nor account id, ask_developer for org_id (plus invoice_id/invoice_month and line_items/amounts/request_ids in the same call if not given). lookup_account.
2. Check billing channel, plan and has_signed_contract on the account.
   - Not billed directly by Redwood: search_knowledge for the procedure for that exact channel (cloud marketplace vs reseller are different pages; apply only the one matching billing_channel). Support credits/disputes nothing there; tell the developer who bills them and where refunds/credits/invoices go. Open a case only if the current page says so (e.g. a metering mismatch).
3. get_invoice (map a month to an id from lookup_account's invoice list). Read console_confirmed_duplicates (original_line vs copy_lines, decided by where the usage records point), same_requests_but_unconfirmed, and same_amount_but_different_requests. get_usage for request ids the developer gave.
4. Classify:
   a. Console-confirmed duplicate: act only on the copy line, never the original.
   b. Look-alike (same amount/description, different request ids), no second line, or usage pointing to neither/both lines: NOT a confirmed duplicate. Say so plainly with the console evidence. Never say a credit is likely before the console confirms a duplicate.
   c. Wrong rate/quantity/product, unrecognized usage, retries/cancelled streams, token mismatch: search the usage/token pages; if they explain it, explain and stop.
   d. Waive/reduce a correct charge (goodwill, exception, SLA credit, refund): not Support's to issue. Load team-handoff.
5. For (a), search_knowledge for what Support may do now: the Support charter (which accounts Support may credit at all), the credits-and-disputes page, and Finance's approval matrix for the per-line limit. The limit can depend on how the invoice was rated (e.g. which price book applies to the invoice's usage period): search the Finance close calendar for that, using the invoice period. Drafts, proposals and threads change nothing.
   - Support may credit this account and the copy line's full amount is within the limit: confirm_with_developer "I'll issue a credit note of $X (full amount) on the duplicated line L of invoice I." Only after yes: issue_credit_note (reason duplicate, memo with request ids). Tell them the credit note id and amount, and when it applies if the page says. No handoff.
   - Over the limit, or an account Support may not credit (e.g. contract/enterprise per the charter): do not credit or split. confirm_with_developer "I'll open a dispute on line L of invoice I (duplicate charge, request ids R) and hand it to Billing Ops." After yes: open_dispute, then load team-handoff and escalate with the dispute id.
   - If the developer says no: write nothing (no credit, dispute or case); say nothing was changed and they can come back.
6. For (b) and unexplained (c): gather intake (invoice, both lines, window in the account's billing timezone, request ids, what they checked) with ask_developer, then load team-handoff.
7. Never promise a dispute outcome or date. If a write is rejected, read get_invoice to see the state before saying anything."}

body: ## Purpose
This charter is the source of truth for what the support agent may and may not do. It takes precedence over proposals, drafts, Slack threads, and older pages where they disagree.
## Credits and disputes
- Support can issue duplicate-charge credit notes only on self-serve accounts.
- Support may not issue a credit note of any amount on an account with a signed contract (Enterprise).
- For a confirmed duplicate on a contract account, open a dispute on the duplicated line (reason `duplicate_charge`, with the request IDs) and hand the case to Billing Ops with the invoice number, the line and the dispute id. Billing Ops applies contract-account adjustments under the contract."}, {"source": "sources/confluence/policies-and-process/delegation-of-authority/support-charter-2027.json", "chunk": "3/4", "kind": "Confluence page", "title": "Support Charter 2027: What the Support Agent May and May Not Do", "status": "published", "date": "2027-03-24", "text": "## Support may
- Look up a customer's billing account, invoices, usage and credits in the console, and answer from them.
- Explain billing behaviour from the published pages.
- Issue a duplicate-charge credit note on a self-serve account, within the limit Finance sets.
- Open a dispute on a duplicated line.
- Open a case with the team the routing page names, and tell the customer who has it.
## Support may not
- Issue goodwill, SLA or exception credits, or any refund.
- Promise an amount, an outcome or a date for something another team decides.
- Change payment methods or take card numbers.
- Quote figures from a customer's contract.
- Change a customer's plan, limits or reservation."}, {"source": "sources/confluence/customer-success-and-support/support-process/invoice-pay-collections-for-enterprise-2027.json", "chunk": "1/1", "kind": "Confluence page", "title": "Enterprise Invoice-Pay Accounts: Collections and Retries", "status": "published", "date": "2027-01-26", "text": "title: Enterprise Invoice-Pay Accounts: Collections and Retries

body: ## Scope
Enterprise accounts that pay by bank transfer against net-30 invoices. They have no card on file, so card autopay and processor retries do not apply to them. This page is not about card payments that fail during a payment-processor incident; see the processor incidents page for those.
## Collections
- Billing Ops sends a reminder 5 days after the due date and retries an ACH pull on day 7.
- Questions go to the account team.
_Last reviewed 2027-01-26._"}, {"source": "sources/confluence/finance-and-legal/billing-controls/support-console-credit-ledger-2027.json", "chunk": "3/3", "kind": "Confluence page", "title": "Support Console: Credit Ledger (April 2027)", "status": "published", "date": "2027-04-01", "text": "## Expiry dates
Each grant has its own expiry date, shown on its grant entry. When a customer holds several grants, give the balance and the expiry date of each one, not only the total.
## Applying credits
Credits are applied automatically to the next invoice, oldest expiry first. Support doesn't move credits between invoices or accounts.
## Why the change
`credit_grants` stored one remaining amount per grant, updated in place, so a wrong update left no history. The ledger keeps every change, which Finance needs for revenue recognition and audits.
## Questions
Ask in #support-billing. Page owner: Dev Patel.

The console's `credit_ledger` table has one entry per grant, application to an invoice, expiry or reinstatement. A grant's balance is the sum of its entries.

Decided at the Finance x Support sync on 2027-03-29 (Fireflies recording "Finance x Support sync: credit ledger cut-over"), including what happens to `credit_grants`."}, {"source": "sources/confluence/customer-success-and-support/support-process/support-console-duplicate-charges-and-disputes-2027.json", "chunk": "4/7", "kind": "Confluence page", "title": "Support Console: Duplicate-Charge Credits and Billing Disputes (v2)", "status": "published", "date": "2027-02-26", "text": "## What Support never credits

body: ## Purpose
The support console can look up a customer's billing account, issue a credit note against invoice lines, and open a billing dispute. This page defines when Support uses each one. It amends the billing routing page for duplicate charges only; everything else on that page still applies. This version is effective from 26 February 2027 and adds how to tell the copy from the original. Support's per-line limit is set in Finance's Billing Adjustments Approval Matrix (Finance shared drive), which FP&A revised in February 2027; check the matrix for the limit that applies to the invoice in front of you."}, {"source": "sources/confluence/customer-success-and-support/support-process/support-console-duplicate-charges-and-disputes-2027.json", "chunk": "3/7", "kind": "Confluence page", "title": "Support Console: Duplicate-Charge Credits and Billing Disputes (v2)", "status": "published", "date": "2027-02-26", "text": "(continued) ## Duplicate charges: what Support may credit
| Situation | What Support does |
|---|---|
| Confirmed duplicate, duplicated line over the limit | Don't credit. Open a dispute on the duplicated line (reason `duplicate_charge`, with the request IDs) and hand the case to Billing Ops with the invoice number, the line and the dispute id. |
| Duplicate the console doesn't confirm (different request IDs, or no second line) | Don't credit. Collect the intake details and hand the case to Billing Ops as the routing page describes. |
Credit or dispute the copy, not the original. Each request's usage record names the invoice line that bills it; of the two lines, the one no usage record points to is the duplicated line.
The limit is per duplicated line and applies to the line's full amount. Don't split a larger duplicate into several smaller credits."}, {"source": "sources/confluence/product-docs/pricing-and-packaging/discounting-and-credits-policy-for-usage-based-products.json", "chunk": "14/20", "kind": "Confluence page", "title": "Discounting and Credits Policy for Usage-Based Products", "status": "published", "date": "2026-02-22", "text": "## Approval matrix (discounts and credits)
Approvals are required **before** sending a quote/Order Form, and before issuing credits that affect an invoice (unless covered by pre-approved support remediation bands).
Table: Approval requirements (minimum)
| Change type | Threshold (USD impact) | Who can approve | Required documentation |
|---|---:|---|---|
| Unit price discount (standard band) | <= $25k ARR equivalent or <= 10% effective discount | CRO (Jordan Blake) + Finance delegate (FP&A) | Deal record + pricing rationale |
| Unit price discount (non-standard) | > 10% or impacts gross margin model | CFO (Laura Bennett) + CRO | Deal record + margin impact summary |
| Promotional/trial credits | <= $10k total per account per quarter | CRO or CPO delegate + Finance delegate | Deal record + campaign/justification |
| Promotional/trial credits | > $10k per quarter | CFO + CRO | Written justification + expected conversion plan |
| Service credits (billing dispute / SLA) | <= $5k per invoice | Support manager + Finance (RevRec) | Support ticket + incident/billing evidence |"}, {"source": "sources/confluence/customer-success-and-support/support-process/support-console-billing-credits-and-disputes.json", "chunk": "3/4", "kind": "Confluence page", "title": "Support Console: Duplicate-Charge Credits and Billing Disputes", "status": "published SUPERSEDED by 'Support Console: Duplicate-Charge Credits and Billing Disputes (v2)' effective 2027-02-26", "date": "2026-02-05", "text": "(continued) ## Duplicate charges: what Support may credit
| Situation | What Support does |
|---|---|
| Confirmed duplicate, duplicated line over the limit | Don't credit. Open a dispute on the duplicated line (reason `duplicate_charge`, with the request IDs) and hand the case to Billing Ops with the invoice number, the line and the dispute id. |
| Duplicate the console doesn't confirm (different request IDs, or no second line) | Don't credit. Collect the intake details and hand the case to Billing Ops as the routing page describes. |
Support's limit is set by Finance in the Billing Adjustments Approval Matrix (Finance shared drive) (the duplicate-charge credit row). It is per duplicated line and applies to the line's full amount. Don't split a larger duplicate into several smaller credits."}, {"source": "sources/confluence/customer-success-and-support/support-process/support-console-billing-credits-and-disputes.json", "chunk": "2/4", "kind": "Confluence page", "title": "Support Console: Duplicate-Charge Credits and Billing Disputes", "status": "published SUPERSEDED by 'Support Console: Duplicate-Charge Credits and Billing Disputes (v2)' effective 2027-02-26", "date": "2026-02-05", "text": "## Look up the account first
- Look up the customer's billing account in the console before you quote an amount, a plan, an invoice line, or whether a charge is a duplicate. You can find the account by its account id or by the customer's org name; ask for one of them if the customer hasn't given either.
- Quote amounts as the console shows them. Don't restate a figure the customer gives you as fact.
## Duplicate charges: what Support may credit
A charge is a confirmed duplicate only when the console shows two lines on the same direct Redwood invoice that bill the same request IDs. A similar description or the same amount on its own is not enough.
| Situation | What Support does |
|---|---|
| Confirmed duplicate, duplicated line within Support's limit | Issue one credit note with reason `duplicate` for the full amount of the duplicated line, against that line. No handoff is needed. Tell the customer the amount credited. |"}]}

content: ## Purpose
This page sets the 2027 monthly close for usage-based invoices: when each month's invoices are cut, which usage lands in which invoice period, and how late usage is handled. Billing Ops, Telemetry and Support use it when a customer asks what a month's invoice covers.
## Monthly close calendar
| Business day | Step | Owner |
|---|---|---|
| BD1 | Usage for the closed month is frozen in the metering warehouse | Telemetry |
| BD2 | Usage is rated against the account's price book and invoice lines are drafted | Billing Ops |
| BD3 | Variance review: lines more than 25% above the prior month are checked against usage | Billing Ops |
| BD4 | Invoices are issued and autopay is attempted on the due date shown on the invoice | Billing Ops |
| BD5 | Revenue for the month is booked and the period is closed | Accounting |"}, {"source": "sources/google_drive/shared_drives/finance/2027-close-calendar-and-invoice-periods.json", "chunk": "3/4", "kind": "Drive doc", "title": "2027 Close Calendar and Invoice Periods", "status": "final", "date": "2027-02-22", "text": "## Late usage
Usage that reaches the warehouse after BD1 is not added to an issued invoice. It is billed on the next month's invoice as a separate line marked "prior-period usage" with the original dates, so a customer comparing a month's export to its invoice may see those requests a month later.
## Price changes
A price-book change applies to usage from the first period that starts on or after its effective date. Mid-period changes are not prorated unless the order form says so.
The 2027 price book takes effect for usage from 1 March 2027: February 2027 and earlier usage is rated on the 2026 price book, and March 2027 usage onward on the 2027 price book."}, {"source": "sources/google_drive/shared_drives/finance/2027-price-book-rollout-plan.json", "chunk": "1/1", "kind": "Drive doc", "title": "2027 price book rollout plan (DRAFT)", "status": "draft", "date": "2026-12-15", "text": "title: 2027 price book rollout plan (DRAFT)

body: ## Pricing
Batch API jobs are billed at 50% of the Hosted API per-token rate for the same model, with a completion window of 24 hours.
## How it shows on an invoice
Batch usage is billed on its own invoice lines, one per week, described as "Batch jobs, <start>-<end>". Each line links to the jobs it bills.
## Limits
- Up to 50,000 requests per job.
- Jobs that don't finish in 24 hours are cancelled; finished requests in a cancelled job are billed, unfinished ones are not.

body: ## Purpose
How solutions engineers estimate a prospect's monthly tokens before a quote. Estimates use an approximate tokenizer and round up 10% for safety. This page is about forecasting before purchase. It does not explain how billed tokens are counted on an invoice; for that, see the token accounting pages and the billing routing page.
## Method
1. Sample 100 representative requests.
2. Count characters and divide by 4 for English text.
3. Multiply by expected monthly volume and add 10%.

- On the writable tables (`cases`, `credit_notes`, `disputes`) the account field is now `billing_account_id`, on reads and writes. Its value is the account's `account_id`.
- A write or query on those tables that still sends `account_id` fails with an unknown-field error. Read-only tables keep `account_id`.
## Billing timezone
- Accounts have a `billing_timezone` (an IANA name such as `America/Los_Angeles`; `UTC` unless set).
- Which billing month and invoice line a request belongs to is set by Finance's invoice period rules; see Finance's 2027 Close Calendar and Invoice Periods (Finance shared drive)."}]}

## After a credit note
- The credit is applied to the next invoice, or to the invoice being issued if it is issued before the close (see Finance's close calendar).

body: ## Purpose
The support console can look up a customer's billing account, issue a credit note against invoice lines, and open a billing dispute. This page defines when Support uses each one. It amends the billing routing page for duplicate charges only; everything else on that page still applies. This version is effective from 26 February 2027 and adds how to tell the copy from the original. Support's per-line limit is set in Finance's Billing Adjustments Approval Matrix (Finance shared drive), which FP&A revised in February 2027; check the matrix for the limit that applies to the invoice in front of you."}, {"source": "sources/google_drive/shared_drives/finance/billing-adjustments-approval-matrix.json", "chunk": "3/7", "kind": "Drive doc", "title": "Billing Adjustments Approval Matrix", "status": "final", "date": "2027-02-26", "text": "## Approval matrix
| Adjustment | Who issues it | Limit and approver |
|---|---|---|
| Duplicate-charge credit (console-confirmed duplicate line on a direct invoice) | Support, from the support console | Invoices rated on the 2027 price book: up to $250 per duplicated line. Invoices rated on an earlier price book: up to $500 per duplicated line (Finance's 2027 Close Calendar and Invoice Periods gives the usage each price book applies to). Over the limit, Support opens a dispute and Billing Ops takes it |
| Billing-error correction other than a duplicate (wrong rate, quantity or product) | Billing Ops | Up to $2,000 per invoice; above that, the Controller |
| Refund of a paid invoice line after an approved adjustment | Billing Ops | Up to $5,000; above that, the Controller |
| Goodwill credit, waiver, or exception to a billing rule | Finance (FP&A) | Any amount, decided in FP&A's review. Support and Billing Ops route these requests and never issue them |
| SLA credit on a self-serve account | Finance (FP&A) | Self-serve plans carry no SLA. FP&A reviews any request as goodwill |"}, {"source": "sources/confluence/customer-success-and-support/support-process/support-console-billing-credits-and-disputes.json", "chunk": "1/4", "kind": "Confluence page", "title": "Support Console: Duplicate-Charge Credits and Billing Disputes", "status": "published SUPERSEDED by 'Support Console: Duplicate-Charge Credits and Billing Disputes (v2)' effective 2027-02-26", "date": "2026-02-05", "text": "title: Support Console: Duplicate-Charge Credits and Billing Disputes

Name the action, the invoice line and, for a credit, the amount. For example: "I'll issue a credit note for the duplicated line L2 on invoice INV-…, for the full amount of that line.
